description: Chain Heal Level 60 260 Mana 40 yd range 2.5 sec cast Requires Shaman Requires level 40 Heals the friendly target for 246 to 281, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets.
name: Chain Heal
